title: ExecutionOrder
description: Order parameters submitted to the execution edge.

type.description: Raw MT5 order type: 0=buy, 1=sell for deal; 2=buy limit, 3=sell limit, 4=buy stop, 5=sell stop for pending.

price.description: Execution price for deal, or the trigger price of a pending order (required for pending).

expiration.description: Expiration instant of a pending order, in epoch seconds UTC. Omitted means good-till-cancelled.

deviation.description: Maximum allowed price slippage in points.

magic.description: Broker-visible magic number derived from intent_id.

comment.description: Broker-visible order comment derived from intent_id.

type_time.description: MT5 order expiration type (e.g. GTC, DAY).
